fields.description: Aquamarine Beach Residences brings one- to three-bedroom homes and selected duplex layouts to Sobha Siniya Island. Apartment types differ in how they combine the suite with a balcony, yard or terrace. Shared courtyards and water-oriented leisure areas support the setting, while the reviewed brochure identifies Tower C as the furnished collection.

overview: The three-bedroom Type A combines an approximately 1,286 sq ft suite with a much larger terrace contribution. By contrast, the small one-bedroom Type A uses a compact balcony. Compare enclosed and outdoor components rather than relying on the project-wide size range.
research.locationNote: Sobha Siniya Island, Umm Al Quwain. Island golf, marina and leisure facilities are wider master-community amenities; their access and opening arrangements need confirmation.
